name: opt_inherit1.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (d Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptBase (mk-OptBase (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptDerived (mk-OptDerived (x Int)(z Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptBase (sel-OptBase OptBase))
  (lift-OptDerived (sel-OptDerived OptDerived))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptBase (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptBase ((this Ref)) OptBase
  (sel-OptBase (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptDerived ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptDerived (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptDerived ((this Ref)) OptDerived
  (sel-OptDerived (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptBase ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-OptBase this)
    (deref-is-OptDerived this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptDerived ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptDerived this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.d: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!d ((this Ref)) Ref
  (d (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class OptBase:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for OptBase.x: ---

(define-fun OptBase!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OptBase this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class OptDerived:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for OptDerived.x: ---

(define-fun OptDerived!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OptDerived this))
)

; --- getters for OptDerived.z: ---

(define-fun OptDerived!z ((this Ref)) Int
  (z (deref-OptDerived this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptDerived (TopLevelDeclarations!d this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptBase:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptBase OptBase)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptBase.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptBase!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptBase.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptBase.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptBase!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptBase.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptDerived:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-OptDerived OptDerived)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptDerived.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptDerived!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptDerived.inv1 2) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptDerived.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptDerived!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptDerived.inv2 2) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OptDerived.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptDerived!z this) (OptDerived!x this))
)

(assert (! (OptDerived.inv3 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun OptDerived.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptDerived!z this) 20)
)

(assert (! (OptDerived.inv4 2) :named _xkassert6))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(maximize (let ((this 2)) (OptDerived!z this)))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptBase const-1-OptBase))
        2 (lift-OptDerived const-2-OptDerived))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-OptBase () OptBase
  (mk-OptBase 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OptDerived (select heap 2))) 10))
(define-fun const-2-OptDerived () OptDerived
  (mk-OptDerived 1 20))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OptBase (select heap 1))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (>= (z (sel-OptDerived (select heap 2))) (x (sel-OptDerived (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (d (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptDerived a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OptDerived (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (<= (z (sel-OptDerived (select heap 2))) 20))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OptBase (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2)))
                  1
                  (lift-OptBase (mk-OptBase 0)))))
  (store a!1 2 (lift-OptDerived (mk-OptDerived 1 20)))))
